'''House Hax''' was an [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] house that was based in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]. House Hax controlled a number of [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworlds]] in the region, including [[Antiquity]], [[Denebia]] and [[Suliana]]. They also had operations on the trade [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Osmani]].
